Create an original production-ready high-detail 2.5D isometric industrial game environment sprite atlas inspired by the ATTACHED USER REFERENCE image. This is a GAME SPRITE SHEET, not a screenshot. Output image size 1536x1024, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal 512x512 cells, TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Every object fits fully inside its own cell with generous empty transparent gutters, nothing clipped, nothing crosses a cell boundary. All assets use exactly the same orthographic 3/4 isometric 2:1 game camera, viewed from above toward north-east, top surfaces visible, building verticals vertical. Match the reference's sophisticated gritty realistically rendered 3D appearance: dark weathered gunmetal, rust, detailed bolts, cables, ducts, corrugation, dirty concrete, tiny emissive warm amber lights and cyan machinery. Directional cold diffuse light from upper-left, small warm local lamps; no black muddy silhouettes, edges and surfaces legible when rendered at 200 pixels. These objects must be ORIGINAL design, with NO words, labels, numbers, logos, GUI or frames. No characters, monsters, weapons, floor tiles, full scenes, giant ground plane, smoke clouds or baked background shadows.
Cell 1 top-left: an imposing complex industrial FACTORY FACADE, broad front wall and short right return wall, dense horizontal pipes, two catwalks with steel railings, ladder, ducts, valves, vents, orange glowing rectangular windows, high-detail exposed steel. Reference factory wall left side. Keep wall structure rectangular and self-contained, front faces diagonal down-right across the image. Cell2 top-middle: tall weathered metal COOLING TOWER / industrial smoke stack with ring catwalk, ladders, cross braces, thick bent pipe feeding side; no huge smoke plume. Cell3 top-right: closed dark steel SHIPPING CONTAINER with ribbed sides, a small stacked crate group against its front corner, tiny amber work lights.
Cell4 bottom-left: CYAN ENERGY GENERATOR, chunky steel hexagonal base, vertically glowing blue-cyan energy cylinder encased in mechanical ribs, small control box, cabling, orange hazard accents. Cell5 bottom-middle: cluster of rusty red and steel BARRELS next to a portable orange INDUSTRIAL WORK LAMP on a tripod and a coiled cable, tight composition. Cell6 bottom-right: damaged industrial RAILING SEGMENT, three concrete barrier blocks with yellow/black worn hazard paint, small rubble and exposed rebar. Each composition's ground contact is centered near the bottom of its cell, under object at y=470 of the local cell. Tall objects fill cell height while leaving 25px padding. Lower props also at least 280px wide and visibly detailed. Transparent background means real alpha, do not draw checkerboards.
